div.head: III Eg 5.2
div.ab: ⁊ þær beo on ðære scire biscop ⁊ se ealdorman, ⁊ þær ægðer tæcan ge Godes riht ge woruldriht.
⁊ ðær beo on þære scire bisceop ⁊ se ealderman, ⁊ ðær ægþer tæcen ge Godes riht ge woruldryht.
⁊ þær beo on þære scire biscop ⁊ se ealdorman, ⁊ þær ægþer tæcan ge Godes riht ge woroldriht.
Et intersit presul comitatus et aldremannus, et utrumque doceant Dei rectum et seculi.
⁊ ðær beo on þare scire biscop ⁊ se ealdorman, ⁊ ðar ægðer tæcan Godes riht ge worldriht.
And the bishop of the diocese and the ealdorman shall be present, and shall direct the observance of both ecclesiastical and secular law.
And in the shire-meeting the bishop and the ealdorman are to be present, and there to expound both the ecclesiastical and the secular law.
Und hier sei anwesend der Diöcesanbischof und der Ealdorman, und sie sollen dort beides, sowohl Kirchenrecht wie weltliches Recht anordnen.
And let the bishop of the shire and the ealdorman be present there, and let them both direct there both God's law and secular law.
